title: Dual Hosting Strategy — V1 on Vercel + V2 on Cloudflare
description: Deploy portfolio-v1 to Vercel and portfolio-v2 to Cloudflare Workers. Single codebase, two production deployments, two domains. V1 becomes the stable legacy site on Vercel. V2 becomes the cutting-edge shadcn registry site on Cloudflare edge.

context.currentV1: Deployed to Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext (wrangler deploy)
context.currentV2: No deployment config — runs locally on localhost:3000
context.monorepo: Root contains both portfolio-v1/ and portfolio-v2/ directories
context.v1Stack: Next.js 16, React 18, Tailwind v3, npm, Node 22
context.v2Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, pnpm, Node 24, Bun scripts

architecture.overview: Two independent deployments from one monorepo. Each has its own CI/CD pipeline, domain, and deployment target.

routing.v2: v2.namias.tech — shadcn registry, components, blocks, new blog
